retrievalProfile.description: A raw, textured neo-expressionist style featuring a central animal figure surrounded by energetic hand-drawn symbols and high-contrast serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic, textured illustration of a howling wolf rendered in dark blues and reds against a gritty, sand-colored background. The composition is framed by a rough, hand-drawn border and punctuated by primitive arrow symbols pointing toward the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-Background: High contrast between the dark, cool-toned wolf and the warm, light-textured ground.
Symbolic Interaction: Hand-drawn arrows create a sense of external pressure or directionality toward the central figure.
Text-to-Image: Large display serif at the top balances the smaller, handwritten-style text in the bottom corner.
Texture-to-Form: Heavy, visible strokes define the fur and movement, giving the image a tactile, physical quality.
coreInvariants: Heavy oil pastel or crayon texture with visible grain
A howling or active animal silhouette as the focal point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large howling wolf occupies the center-right, angled diagonally to suggest upward movement.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The wolf's head and open mouth serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left title, follows the arrows toward the wolf's head, and descends to the bottom-right subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The background is densely textured but serves as negative space to isolate the dark silhouette of the wolf.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between background and subject; saturated red accents provide focal points within the dark subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, deep blues, and primary red.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature a thin red outline to separate them from the busy background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal, high-contrast serif for the main title paired with a raw, visceral handwritten script for the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary classical serif structure for the title.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Rough Crayon or Oil Pastel Script
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the textural quality of the background art.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a neo-expressionist oil pastel illustration of a howling wolf in dark blue and red. Use a heavily textured sand-colored background with visible wax strokes. Include primitive hand-drawn arrows and a rough, scribbled border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main title in the top left using a high-contrast serif font with a red outline. Add a handwritten-style subtitle in the bottom right with a waxy texture and a red underline.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture sufficiently grainy and tactile?
Do the arrows point toward the central figure?
Is the title font a sharp serif with a red outline?
Is the border hand-drawn and irregular?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific band name or album title text
Do not replicate the exact wolf silhouette; create a unique expressive animal
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red accents are vibrant against the dark blue.
Check that the text is legible despite the heavy background texture.
Verify the 'scratched-in' look of the background details.
Confirm the composition feels balanced but energetic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Animal Subject] + [Oil Pastel Texture] + [Primitive Symbols/Arrows] + [Classical Serif Title] + [Rough Border]
